the_idea_tested.owner_proposal: enter an arbitrary environment, scan everything, diff the scan against memory, and what is not matched is what to go and learn
the_idea_tested.verdict: the mechanism works; the naive form of it is worthless; two specific defects had to be found first

what_was_already_in_the_project.environment_probe_v1: snapshot(root) -> path/(size,mtime) -- observation with no notion of kind
what_was_already_in_the_project.discover_v1: binaries() and entrypoints() -- reads what exists, not what it can read
what_was_already_in_the_project.ignorance_ledger_v1: ranked gaps, value = p_useful/(1+cost), Beta prior (untried 0.5, tried-and-useless 0.045)
what_was_already_in_the_project.jit_knowledge_v1: the instant-knowledge channel; needs >=2 independent sources before anything counts as known
what_was_already_in_the_project.cli_contract_inference_v1: MAGIC_BY_SUFFIX -- suffix->magic table; the exact wrong shape this round replaces
what_was_already_in_the_project.missing: nothing joined scan -> diff -> ranked gap. That join is this round's work.

what_the_frontier_shows.look_before_you_leap_2605.16143: task-oriented training does NOT reliably yield exploration; NAIVE exploration can HURT performance; Explore-then-Act decouples information gathering from task execution
what_the_frontier_shows.studying_without_a_syllabus_2609.10824: an open-ended meta-agent that studies an environment task-agnostically and CHOOSES what artifacts to produce beats fixed preprocessing on 5 of 6 benchmarks -- the owner's idea, validated
what_the_frontier_shows.agentcl_2606.02461: continual learning is NOT solved by storing more trajectories; the hard part is deciding what to abstract, retrieve or ignore, and whether reuse was genuine or incidental
what_the_frontier_shows.skillrl_2602.08234: raw trajectories are redundant and noise-heavy; abstraction into skills is what transfers (10-20x compression, better utility)

two_defects_found_by_measurement.defect: the scanner used `python3 -m py_compile` as its python validator
two_defects_found_by_measurement.why_it_mattered: py_compile WRITES __pycache__ next to the file. A scan of intake/ then read the .pyc files its own validator had created and reported markdown as `json+python+utf8_text` -- a measurement that changes the thing it measures
two_defects_found_by_measurement.fix: ast.parse, which judges the same property and writes nothing

two_defects_found_by_measurement.defect: every kind nothing can read shares the signature `()`
two_defects_found_by_measurement.why_it_mattered: learning it made the FIRST unreadable file teach memory that unreadable bytes are a known kind, so every later unknown file was reported KNOWN -- the machine confidently claiming to know exactly the things it did not know
two_defects_found_by_measurement.fix: `()` is never learned; absence is never evidence

the_retraction.claim_i_made_then_withdrew: signature keying transfers better than suffix keying (0.8 vs 0.6)
the_retraction.why_withdrawn: that number came from nine hand-made files in two tiny directories
the_retraction.real_measurement: leave-one-out over 100 real files: signature 100/100, suffix 100/100, signatures buy 0 -- the repository holds only three signature classes, so any key that has seen a .json recognises the next one
the_retraction.what_signatures_do_buy: lying names. Of seven test files, three declare a kind their bytes are refused by (lying.json does not parse, lying.py does not parse, lying.png is not a PNG). A suffix rule calls all three known; the content signature catches all three

measured.scan_cost: 40 files: 5.1 s -> 1.9 s after necessary-magic skipping; unzip -t alone was ~0.2 s per file
measured.real_transfer: learned on canonical/verification + canonical/action_intents, scanned intake/: 40 files, 27 KNOWN, 13 UNKNOWN, 0 unread
measured.ranked_gaps: an unaccepted kind ranks value 0.250 over half-known kinds at 0.167, from ignorance_ledger_v1's own formula rather than a rule written here
measured.validators: json, python, utf8_text, png, gzip, tar, zip -- each one REJECTS what is not its kind; `cat` is deliberately excluded because it accepts everything

honest_limits: the mechanism transfers only among KINDS the machine has a declared validator for; a kind with no validator is UNKNOWN forever until one exists, and that is the real bottleneck
seven validators is a seed, not coverage; the repository's own file kinds (docx, xlsx, pdf) are not covered
no fetching was joined in this round: the scan produces the gap list and jit_knowledge_v1 can resolve a gap, but the automatic scan->fetch->verify round trip was not measured
no benchmark task was run; this is a mechanism measurement
authority NONE, sandbox only, independent verification OPEN
next_bottleneck: the VALIDATOR SET is the ceiling. Coverage of kinds is what decides how much of an unseen environment can be called known, and adding validators is the thing to make cheap and automatic -- a program's own declaration of what it accepts is the source, the same join as round 9's declared producer
